cohort: The study included 61 pregnant women diagnosed with placenta previa admitted to the Obstetric department in P.D.U. medical college and hospital, Rajkot over a period of one year.
finding: The study revealed a high prevalence of emergency cesarean sections (73.77%), postpartum haemorrhage (18.03%), perinatal morbidity (42.62%), and perinatal death (17.46%) among patients with placenta previa.
mod_finding: The majority of deliveries in patients with placenta previa (73.77%) were performed by emergency cesarean section.
birth_weight: Poor survival rate was observed with extremely low birth weight babies.
